account_number_suffix.description: The last 4 digits of the bank account.

statement_period_start.description: The start date of the reporting period.

statement_period_end.description: The end date of the reporting period.

opening_balance.description: The balance at the very start of the period.

closing_balance.description: The balance at the very end of the period.

transaction_date.description: The date the transaction cleared the bank.

description.description: The bank memo, payee name, or transaction details.

amount.description: The value of the transaction (Positive for deposits, Negative for withdrawals).

reference_number.description: Check number, wire ID, or transaction sequence number.

transaction_type.description: Classification provided by the bank (e.g., ACH, DEBIT, FEE, INTEREST).
